summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Zendesk OAuth Client Config UI feature. All 19 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all critical elements working correctly: OAuth Setup Required form with Client ID/Secret inputs, Save Credentials button, transition to subdomain+Connect form after saving, masked client ID display, remove credentials button, and success/removal toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - OAuth client config follows singleton pattern with _id: 'credentials' in MongoDB
Client secret is never returned to frontend - only masked client_id is shown (first 4 chars + ***)
_get_oauth_credentials_async correctly checks DB first, then falls back to env vars
Frontend state management handles all transitions correctly (setup → configured → removed)
Proper validation for empty/whitespace-only credentials on backend
seed_data_creation: Test OAuth credentials created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zendesk OAuth Client Config UI fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/client-config (saves credentials), GET /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/client-config (returns configured status and masked client_id), DELETE /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/client-config (removes credentials). Frontend page at /admin/zendesk has data-testid attributes: zendesk-oauth-client-id-input, zendesk-oauth-client-secret-input, zendesk-save-oauth-client-btn, zendesk-remove-oauth-client-btn, zendesk-subdomain-input, zendesk-oauth-connect-btn. Credentials are stored in MongoDB zendesk_oauth_client collection with _id: 'credentials' as singleton pattern.

POST /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/client-config saves OAuth client credentials and returns success
features_tested.details: Returns {success: true, message: 'Zendesk OAuth client credentials saved.'}

Returns {success: true, message: 'OAuth client credentials removed.'}

features_tested.feature: GET /api/admin/zendesk-config returns oauth_configured:false after credentials are removed
features_tested.details: oauth_configured correctly updates to false after deletion

features_tested.feature: POST /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/start works when credentials are stored in DB (not env vars)
features_tested.details: Returns redirect_url with client_id from DB credentials

features_tested.details: All form elements with correct data-testid attributes present

features_tested.details: Success toast 'OAuth credentials saved!' shown, form transitions to subdomain input
